ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Control Panel DLL Load
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious Rundll32 execution from control.exe as used by Equation Group and Exploit Kits

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\System32\\\\control\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*Shell32\\\.dll.*"))
